title: Connected TV Advertising: Everything You Need to Know | International Advertising Solutions

facts.fact: Connected TV devices include smart TVs, gaming consoles, and streaming sticks, which let viewers stream videos, listen to music, and browse the web.
facts.quote: These devices, such as smart TVs, gaming consoles, and streaming sticks, allow viewers to stream videos, listen to music, and browse the web seamlessly

facts.fact: The page states that OTT describes the method of content delivery, while CTV describes the devices used to view content.
facts.quote: OTT refers to the method of content delivery, while CTV refers to the devices used to view the content, such as smart TVs or gaming consoles.

facts.fact: The page says Amazon Streaming TV ads are currently purchased programmatically, meaning they are bought and sold through an automated system.
facts.quote: Currently, Amazon Streaming TV ads are purchased programmatically, meaning that the ads are bought and sold digitally through an automated system

facts.fact: The page says CTV advertising can display ads in premium TV shows, news video apps, and Twitch livestreams.
facts.quote: This form of digital advertising can display ads in premium TV shows, news video apps, Twitch livestreams, and more

facts.fact: The page states that CTV interactive ad formats can include clickable overlays, quizzes, or shoppable ads.
facts.quote: These formats can include clickable overlays, quizzes, or shoppable ads that make the viewing experience more immersive and engaging.

facts.fact: The page states that once a traditional TV ad has aired, changes cannot be made, unlike CTV campaigns that offer real-time analytics for on-the-fly optimization.
facts.quote: where changes cannot be made once the ad is aired.
